releaseNotes: AutoWave Radio v5.28.0: Shuffle is remembered like Lyrics (car and phone stay in sync); favourites found in online search now appear in Favorites; Unblock All no longer brings old blocks back; Previous works on the first press and across folders; a failing last station moves on instead of going silent; blocking no longer skips an extra station; voice next/previous station works; sleep timer and car-disconnect shutdown fixed; web player: reconnects when a stream drops, lyrics sync redesign and clean song names.
